e3b0d18acd.q: How many data centers does Virginia have operating and under construction?
e3b0d18acd.a: Virginia has 663 operating data centers and 595 under construction. Texas is right behind Virginia as the second state for data centers. These facilities demand a tremendous amount of energy, and their energy requirements are projected to triple over the next 20 years.
e3b0d18acd.e: Episode 39 - Jobs, Data Centers, and the Energy Reality Governors Can’t Ignore
e3b0d18acd.rq: I've always governed in reality. I tried to do things every day to have a good energy mix that was dependable, reliable, and affordable.
ks: Virginia has 663 operating data centers and 595 under construction
Virginia's energy mix: approximately 50% natural gas, 30-32% nuclear, 8% wind and solar
Virginia utility bills increased 9.5% last year
Projected energy requirement increase over the next 20 years: triple
One out of 20 Americans today are in utility debt
e3b0d18acd.gt: Chair of the Virginia State Campaign for Natural Allies for a Clean Energy Future Coalition at Natural Allies for a Clean Energy Future Coalition

14499c9741.q: What is Virginia's current energy mix by source?
14499c9741.a: In Virginia, about 50 percent comes from natural gas, about 30 to 32 percent from nuclear, and wind and solar together account for 8 percent. McAuliffe emphasizes that while he supports renewables, it is not possible to shut down nuclear and gas infrastructure in five years.

d44682aa02.q: What manufacturing projects did Virginia lose during McAuliffe's governorship due to energy infrastructure?
d44682aa02.a: McAuliffe lost two major manufacturing projects—one from Qatar and one from Egypt that would have gone to Southwest Virginia—because Dominion's head Tom Farrell could not provide long-term gas contracts required by the facilities to build their plants. Without reliable long-term gas supply infrastructure, the companies could not proceed.

cf6abb6060.q: What were the utility bill increases in Virginia in 2024?
cf6abb6060.a: In Virginia last year, utility bills went up 9.5 percent. Nationally, utility bills have increased anywhere from 9 to 16 percent, and one out of 20 Americans today are in what is called utility debt, unable to afford their utility bills.

917067afa9.q: What major wind project did Virginia complete under McAuliffe's governorship?
917067afa9.a: McAuliffe did the biggest wind project utility in American history in Virginia with Dominion, which comes online next year and will light up about 600,000 homes. He also did more solar projects than any governor in the PJM, covering 13 states.
